Olivia (release-eng): T-minus 60m for the EU change window. Posting final checklist + rollback owner assignments. Please ack.
Chris (sre): ack — SRE will own rollback monitoring/alerts.
Arjun (platform): Ill own the pin/unpin and scaling commands. Console ready.
Nina (product): Release notes: https://confluence.redwood/release/rc-3.4.2. No DB schema changes.
Sam (oncall): Im primary for the next 6h. Pager handoff done.
deploy-bot: Canary queued -> id: job-60233 (trigger=Olivia).
Olivia (release-eng): Plan: pin v3.4.2 to eu-dedicated, canary 5% for 15m, ramp to 25% if green, then staged waves. Rollback = unpin + scale down.
Chris (sre): Rollback thresholds: error-rate >= 1.5% for 5m OR p95 > 800ms for 3m. If hit, call rollback and post to #release-war-room.
Arjun (platform): Unpin playbook in case of rollback: `infra unpin --cluster eu-dedicated && infra scale --cluster eu-dedicated --replicas 0 --version v3.4.2 && deploy-bot cancel job-60233`. Ill execute.
Sam (oncall): Running smoke now: `scripts/smoke-eu.sh` (10 reqs).
Sam (oncall): smoke OK: 10/10 200, p95 230ms :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Canary started job-60233 -> 5% @2024-02-14T02:15:00Z
Olivia (release-eng): Reminder: freeze rules in effect — no unrelated infra changes. Only emergency hotfixes via exception channel.
oncall-bot: Quiet window ends at 2024-02-14T06:00:00Z UTC.
Olivia (release-eng): If all green at 20m, Ill approve ramp to 25% then proceed with staged rollout. Ping me for immediate actions. :rocket:
